Pop Culture Jeopardy! is an American television game show. It is a spin-off of Jeopardy!, which was created by Merv Griffin, and focuses on popular culture, including music, films, TV shows, and stage shows. Instead of individual contestants like in Jeopardy!, there are three teams of three contestants. Pop Culture Jeopardy! is hosted by Colin Jost and premiered on Amazon Prime Video on December 4, 2024.
Production
Development
Variety first reported that a spin-off of American game show Jeopardy! was set to be in development on May 14, 2024. British television producer Michael Davies serves as executive producer for the series.
